{
  "title": "Cricket Re-Entry Block: Week 1 Movement Quality",
  "goal": "Sport Performance",
  "sports": ["Cricket"],
  "duration_weeks": 1,
  "athlete_analysis": {
    "profile_summary": "21yo recreational top-order batsman, beginner lifter, gym-trained, building lean muscle and cricket transfer. Mild right knee discomfort after long runs; Sunday match day.",
    "primary_constraints": [
      "Mild right knee discomfort after long runs",
      "6.5h sleep, moderate stress",
      "No heavy legs the day before Sunday match"
    ],
    "sport_demands": [
      "Front-foot control and trunk rotation for batting",
      "Deceleration and turning for strike rotation",
      "Hip/ankle mobility and fielding speed"
    ],
    "block_priority": "Re-entry phase: movement quality, low-impact capacity, knee pain monitoring. Keep loads submaximal, progress only if 24h response is stable."
  },
  "blocks": [
    {
      "name": "Re-Entry",
      "start_week": 1,
      "end_week": 2,
      "emphasis": ["pain_monitoring", "movement_quality", "low_impact_capacity"]
    }
  ],
  "weeks": [
    {
      "week_number": 1,
      "theme": "Build movement quality and tolerate light loading without knee flare",
      "progression_rule": "Keep RPE 6-7. Progress next week only if knee response is stable for 24h and sessions complete.",
      "deload_note": null,
      "workouts": [
        {
          "day": "Monday",
          "title": "Lower Strength: Knee-Friendly Squat Pattern",
          "category": "Strength",
          "duration_min": 75,
          "intensity": "moderate",
          "adaptation_targets": ["Squat mechanics", "Hip control", "Calf capacity"],
          "sport_transfer": [
            "Stable base for front-foot batting stance",
            "Calf/soleus capacity supports fielding push-off"
          ],
          "why_this_session": "Teaches controlled squat depth and hip stability with low knee stress while building calf capacity for fielding, keeping volume conservative in re-entry phase.",
          "warmup": [
            {
              "name": "Lateral Leg Swing",
              "purpose": "Open frontal-plane hip range for squatting and fielding cuts",
              "sets": 1,
              "reps": "8 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "none",
              "load_guidance": null,
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Keep pelvis mostly level", "Move through pain-free range"],
              "substitutions": ["Leg swing front-to-back"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Bird Dog",
              "purpose": "Activate trunk and hip control before loading",
              "sets": 2,
              "reps": "6 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "30s",
              "load_guidance": null,
              "tempo": "slow",
              "coaching_notes": ["Reach long, not high", "Keep ribs down"],
              "substitutions": ["Dead bug"]
            }
          ],
          "main_work": [
            {
              "name": "Goblet Squat",
              "purpose": "Teach squat depth and knee tracking with front load and low joint stress",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "8-10",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "90s",
              "load_guidance": "RPE 6, pain-free depth only",
              "tempo": "3-1-1",
              "coaching_notes": ["Hold weight close to chest", "Stop above any knee discomfort"],
              "substitutions": ["Landmine squat", "Box squat"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Landmine Squat",
              "purpose": "Guided-arc loaded squat that builds leg strength while protecting the knee",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "8",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "90s",
              "load_guidance": "RPE 6-7",
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Hold sleeve close to sternum", "Keep heels grounded"],
              "substitutions": ["Goblet squat", "Safety bar squat"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Standing Calf Raise",
              "purpose": "Build calf/soleus capacity to support knee and fielding push-off",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "12-15",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "60s",
              "load_guidance": "RPE 7, full stretch",
              "tempo": "2-1-2",
              "coaching_notes": ["Use full stretch and full raise", "Control the bottom"],
              "substitutions": ["Single-leg calf raise", "Leg press calf raise"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Pallof Press",
              "purpose": "Anti-rotation trunk strength that transfers to batting rotation control",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "10 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "45s",
              "load_guidance": "light cable, RPE 6",
              "tempo": "slow",
              "coaching_notes": ["Resist rotation, ribs down", "Press straight out"],
              "substitutions": ["Pallof press overhead reach", "Band anti-rotation hold"]
            }
          ],
          "cooldown": [
            {
              "name": "Bird Dog",
              "purpose": "Reinforce trunk control and downregulate after loading",
              "sets": 1,
              "reps": "5 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "none",
              "load_guidance": null,
              "tempo": "slow",
              "coaching_notes": ["Move slow and controlled"],
              "substitutions": ["Dead bug"]
            }
          ],
          "injury_modifications": [
            "Limit squat depth to pain-free range on right knee",
            "Skip any rep that causes knee discomfort",
            "Monitor 24h knee response; regress if symptoms worsen"
          ]
        },
        {
          "day": "Tuesday",
          "title": "Upper Push & Scapular Health",
          "category": "Strength",
          "duration_min": 75,
          "intensity": "moderate",
          "adaptation_targets": ["Horizontal push strength", "Scapular control", "Shoulder durability"],
          "sport_transfer": [
            "Shoulder/scapular durability for throwing and fielding",
            "Upper-body base for bat speed control"
          ],
          "why_this_session": "Develops pressing strength and posterior shoulder capacity to keep shoulders durable for throwing, with simple beginner-friendly movements.",
          "warmup": [
            {
              "name": "Band Pull-Apart",
              "purpose": "Activate posterior shoulder and scapula before pressing",
              "sets": 2,
              "reps": "15",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "30s",
              "load_guidance": "light band",
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Keep ribs down", "Squeeze shoulder blades"],
              "substitutions": ["Prone Y-T-W raise"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Bird Dog",
              "purpose": "Trunk activation to support pressing posture",
              "sets": 1,
              "reps": "6 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "none",
              "load_guidance": null,
              "tempo": "slow",
              "coaching_notes": ["Reach long, not high"],
              "substitutions": ["Dead bug"]
            }
          ],
          "main_work": [
            {
              "name": "Dumbbell Bench Press",
              "purpose": "Build horizontal push strength with natural arm path and shoulder control",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "8-10",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "90s",
              "load_guidance": "RPE 7, leave 2-3 in reserve",
              "tempo": "2-1-1",
              "coaching_notes": ["Set dumbbells over elbows before first rep", "Control the descent"],
              "substitutions": ["Machine chest press", "Dumbbell floor press"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Machine Row",
              "purpose": "Build upper-back strength with low trunk demand for posture and throwing base",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "10-12",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "75s",
              "load_guidance": "RPE 7",
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Adjust pad to torso", "Drive elbows back"],
              "substitutions": ["One-arm dumbbell row", "Chest-supported machine row"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Dumbbell Lateral Raise",
              "purpose": "Develop lateral deltoid for balanced shoulder hypertrophy and durability",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "12-15",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "60s",
              "load_guidance": "light, RPE 7",
              "tempo": "2-0-2",
              "coaching_notes": ["Slight elbow bend", "No shrugging"],
              "substitutions": ["Machine shoulder press"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Face Pull",
              "purpose": "Train scapular control and external rotation for shoulder durability in throwing",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "15",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "60s",
              "load_guidance": "light cable, RPE 6",
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Set cable near face height", "Lead with elbows"],
              "substitutions": ["Band pull-apart", "Prone Y-T-W raise"]
            }
          ],
          "cooldown": [
            {
              "name": "Band Pull-Apart",
              "purpose": "Light posterior shoulder endurance to finish",
              "sets": 1,
              "reps": "20",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "none",
              "load_guidance": "very light",
              "tempo": "slow",
              "coaching_notes": ["Keep ribs down"],
              "substitutions": ["Prone Y-T-W raise"]
            }
          ],
          "injury_modifications": [
            "Stop lateral raise if shoulder pinch occurs",
            "Keep face pull pain-free in external rotation"
          ]
        },
        {
          "day": "Wednesday",
          "title": "Low-Impact Conditioning & Fielding Movement",
          "category": "Conditioning",
          "duration_min": 75,
          "intensity": "moderate",
          "adaptation_targets": ["Aerobic base", "Deceleration", "Hip mobility"],
          "sport_transfer": [
            "Ground-fielding ready position and pickup mechanics",
            "Deceleration control for safe turning in field"
          ],
          "why_this_session": "Builds low-impact aerobic capacity and trains safe fielding deceleration without knee-aggravating long runs, matching re-entry phase goals.",
          "warmup": [
            {
              "name": "Lateral Leg Swing",
              "purpose": "Prepare hips for lateral fielding movement",
              "sets": 1,
              "reps": "10 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "none",
              "load_guidance": null,
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Keep pelvis level"],
              "substitutions": ["Leg swing front-to-back"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Bird Dog",
              "purpose": "Trunk and hip activation before movement work",
              "sets": 2,
              "reps": "6 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "30s",
              "load_guidance": null,
              "tempo": "slow",
              "coaching_notes": ["Reach long, not high"],
              "substitutions": ["Dead bug"]
            }
          ],
          "main_work": [
            {
              "name": "Low-Speed Long Barrier Fielding Drill",
              "purpose": "Rehearse ground-fielding ready position, hips low and soft hands at low speed",
              "sets": 4,
              "reps": "6 feeds",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "60s",
              "load_guidance": "predictable rolling feeds only",
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Hips low, eyes to ball", "Get body behind the line"],
              "substitutions": ["Rolling pickup drill"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Submaximal Shuttle Decelerations",
              "purpose": "Train controlled stopping and turning to build knee-safe deceleration capacity",
              "sets": 5,
              "reps": "10m jog-to-stop",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "60s",
              "load_guidance": "70% effort, soft controlled stops",
              "tempo": "decelerate over 2-3 steps",
              "coaching_notes": ["Sink hips to brake", "No hard cuts if knee reacts"],
              "substitutions": ["Walk-to-jog accelerations"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Stationary Bike Aerobic Intervals",
              "purpose": "Build aerobic base with zero knee impact",
              "sets": 1,
              "reps": null,
              "duration": "15 min, 2min easy / 1min moderate",
              "rest": "none",
              "load_guidance": "RPE 5-6, no knee pain",
              "tempo": "steady",
              "coaching_notes": ["Keep cadence smooth", "Stop if knee aches"],
              "substitutions": ["Rower at moderate effort"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Pallof Press",
              "purpose": "Anti-rotation trunk endurance for fielding throws and batting control",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "10 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "45s",
              "load_guidance": "light cable",
              "tempo": "slow",
              "coaching_notes": ["Resist rotation", "Ribs down"],
              "substitutions": ["Landmine rotation (light)"]
            }
          ],
          "cooldown": [
            {
              "name": "Lateral Leg Swing",
              "purpose": "Restore hip range and downregulate after movement work",
              "sets": 1,
              "reps": "10 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "none",
              "load_guidance": null,
              "tempo": "slow",
              "coaching_notes": ["Relaxed, controlled swings"],
              "substitutions": ["Standing hip circles"]
            }
          ],
          "injury_modifications": [
            "Avoid long continuous runs that trigger knee discomfort",
            "Keep decelerations submaximal and pain-free",
            "Use bike instead of running if knee is reactive"
          ]
        },
        {
          "day": "Friday",
          "title": "Full-Body Strength & Rotational Trunk",
          "category": "Strength",
          "duration_min": 75,
          "intensity": "moderate",
          "adaptation_targets": ["Squat strength", "Lat/back capacity", "Rotational control"],
          "sport_transfer": [
            "Trunk rotation power base for front-foot drives",
            "Lat and back strength for bat control and throwing"
          ],
          "why_this_session": "Combines knee-friendly leg loading with back hypertrophy and light rotational work to transfer toward batting, kept off heavy legs late in the week.",
          "warmup": [
            {
              "name": "Band Pull-Apart",
              "purpose": "Activate scapula and posterior shoulder before pulling",
              "sets": 2,
              "reps": "15",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "30s",
              "load_guidance": "light band",
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Keep ribs down"],
              "substitutions": ["Prone Y-T-W raise"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Lateral Leg Swing",
              "purpose": "Open hips before squatting and rotation",
              "sets": 1,
              "reps": "8 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "none",
              "load_guidance": null,
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Keep pelvis level"],
              "substitutions": ["Leg swing front-to-back"]
            }
          ],
          "main_work": [
            {
              "name": "Goblet Squat",
              "purpose": "Reinforce squat mechanics and leg strength with low knee stress",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "8-10",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "90s",
              "load_guidance": "RPE 6-7, pain-free depth",
              "tempo": "3-1-1",
              "coaching_notes": ["Hold weight close", "Knees track over toes"],
              "substitutions": ["Landmine squat"]
            },
            {
              "name": "One-Arm Dumbbell Row",
              "purpose": "Build unilateral back strength and anti-rotation trunk control for batting",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "10 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "75s",
              "load_guidance": "RPE 7",
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Brace trunk, no twisting", "Drive elbow to hip"],
              "substitutions": ["Machine row"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Dumbbell Pullover",
              "purpose": "Train lat capacity through a long arc for bat-swing and throwing range",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "12",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "60s",
              "load_guidance": "light-moderate, RPE 6",
              "tempo": "slow",
              "coaching_notes": ["Ribs down, no flare", "Pain-free overhead range"],
              "substitutions": ["Single-arm cable pulldown"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Landmine Rotation",
              "purpose": "Introduce controlled trunk rotation transferring to batting drive",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "8 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "60s",
              "load_guidance": "light, RPE 6",
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Rotate from trunk and hips", "Keep arms long"],
              "substitutions": ["Pallof press", "Cable woodchop (light)"]
            }
          ],
          "cooldown": [
            {
              "name": "Bird Dog",
              "purpose": "Reset trunk control and downregulate",
              "sets": 1,
              "reps": "6 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "none",
              "load_guidance": null,
              "tempo": "slow",
              "coaching_notes": ["Reach long, not high"],
              "substitutions": ["Dead bug"]
            }
          ],
          "injury_modifications": [
            "Keep squat depth pain-free on right knee",
            "Keep pullover within comfortable overhead range",
            "Stop rotation if any back or knee discomfort"
          ]
        },
        {
          "day": "Saturday",
          "title": "Pre-Match Primer: Mobility & Activation",
          "category": "Mobility",
          "duration_min": 60,
          "intensity": "easy",
          "adaptation_targets": ["Hip mobility", "Scapular activation", "Light neural primer"],
          "sport_transfer": [
            "Prime hips and trunk for Sunday batting and fielding",
            "Keep legs fresh ahead of match day"
          ],
          "why_this_session": "Match-day-minus-1 primer: mobility, activation, and light technical rehearsal with no heavy legs or fatigue, respecting the schedule constraint and re-entry caution.",
          "warmup": [
            {
              "name": "Lateral Leg Swing",
              "purpose": "Open hip range for fielding and batting movement",
              "sets": 2,
              "reps": "10 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "30s",
              "load_guidance": null,
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Keep pelvis level"],
              "substitutions": ["Standing hip circles"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Band Pull-Apart",
              "purpose": "Activate posterior shoulder for throwing readiness",
              "sets": 2,
              "reps": "15",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "30s",
              "load_guidance": "light band",
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Keep ribs down"],
              "substitutions": ["Prone Y-T-W raise"]
            }
          ],
          "main_work": [
            {
              "name": "Bird Dog",
              "purpose": "Activate trunk stability without fatigue before match day",
              "sets": 2,
              "reps": "8 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "30s",
              "load_guidance": null,
              "tempo": "slow",
              "coaching_notes": ["Reach long, not high", "Keep hips square"],
              "substitutions": ["Dead bug"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Shadow Batting to Target Line",
              "purpose": "Rehearse front-foot defense and drive alignment with no load",
              "sets": 3,
              "reps": "8 reps",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "45s",
              "load_guidance": "technical, easy effort",
              "tempo": "controlled",
              "coaching_notes": ["Head close to contact line", "Play straight early"],
              "substitutions": ["Front-foot defense feed (light)"]
            },
            {
              "name": "Single-Leg Calf Raise",
              "purpose": "Light calf primer for fielding push-off without fatigue",
              "sets": 2,
              "reps": "10 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "45s",
              "load_guidance": "bodyweight, easy",
              "tempo": "2-1-2",
              "coaching_notes": ["Full controlled range", "Light effort only"],
              "substitutions": ["Standing calf raise (light)"]
            }
          ],
          "cooldown": [
            {
              "name": "Lateral Leg Swing",
              "purpose": "Finish with relaxed hip mobility for match-day readiness",
              "sets": 1,
              "reps": "10 each side",
              "duration": null,
              "rest": "none",
              "load_guidance": null,
              "tempo": "slow",
              "coaching_notes": ["Relaxed swings"],
              "substitutions": ["Standing hip circles"]
            }
          ],
          "injury_modifications": [
            "Keep all work easy and pain-free; no heavy legs before match",
            "Skip calf primer if right knee is reactive"
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "nutrition_focus": "Vegetarian lean muscle gain: aim slight surplus, protein each meal (dairy, legumes, paneer, soy). Milk post-session aids recovery and gradual weight gain toward 78kg.",
  "recovery_focus": [
    "Prioritize sleep toward 7.5-8h to support recovery and knee tissue",
    "Light SMR for calves and quads, avoid excruciating pressure on knee",
    "Monitor 24h knee response after each session"
  ],
  "safety_notes": [
    "Re-entry phase: no max testing, sprinting, or plyometrics this week",
    "Right knee mild discomfort: keep squats pain-free and avoid long runs",
    "No heavy legs on Saturday before Sunday match"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "No competition calendar supplied, so match-week rules stay conservative",
    "Loads unknown for beginner, so RPE/tempo guidance is used",
    "Cricket nets/turf available for low-speed sport drills"
  ],
  "notes": [
    "5 workouts match training_days_per_week",
    "Uses preferred days Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat"
  ]
}
